enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Pulls blanket up. Stretches arms. Remains asleep. Turns to back. Remains asleep. Opens eyes briefly. Closes eyes again. Continues sleeping.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wash body. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Wipe mirror. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Select clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Check mirror. Brush hair. Apply deodorant. Pack bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in bag. Pick up keys. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Attend morning meeting. Check patient charts. Visit patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Assist with procedure. Document in computer. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting. Consult with colleague. Visit patient. Update chart. Prepare for next day. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read news. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Remove shoes. Hang coat. Walk to kitchen.

Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Cook. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV, using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Play game. Close laptop. Pick up phone. Scroll social media. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal hygiene and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Apply moisturizer. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on lamp. Set alarm on phone. Plug phone into charger. Pick up book. Read book. Close book. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe slowly.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Pulls blanket up. Stretches legs. Remains asleep. Turns to back. Remains asleep.
